headline: Virtuoso Optoelectronics submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine compliance filing documenting shareholder approvals for resolutions passed at the meeting. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the approved corporate resolutions in the regulatory filing.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate price impact
